record.title: Azerbaijan prolonged pandemic land-entry closure
record.scope: External land crossings otherwise available for ordinary travel
record.direction: Primarily land entry; ordinary bilateral travel restricted
record.exceptions: Freight; exceptional authorised crossings. Exit conditions vary by nationality and require separate checking.
record.enforcement: Czech embassy September 2026 notice confirms current prohibition for ordinary travel.
record.status_observation: Regular land travel remained restricted at 3 September 2026
record.context: Prolonged closure; air entry operates separately. Armenia frontier has a separate longstanding conflict closure.
record.uncertainty: Mainland restrictions began in stages: Iran February 29, Georgia March 14 and Russia March 18, 2020. No simultaneous national onset is implied. Uniform exit rules remain outside the retained road-entry scope. September 3, 2026 is a dated last confirmation, not an assumed cutoff or future extension.
